findings: Server state files, control URLs, authentication, PID/port matching, and start/stop logic are unchanged. Preview server, launchers, and MCP entry only replace display labels.
Portable and license inventory schemas, MCP command and package name remain compatible. productName=KeepAny and previousName=StackPerch are intentional display metadata changes.

Each K and historical S icon must match its corresponding source. Cross-brand equality is removed because the designs differ; ten resources, current PWA icon definitions, favicon reference, and the three root PWA identity fields remain checked.
Source snapshot adds only two current public sample screenshots to the existing whitelist. The prior two paths remain; no other evidence or private local configuration is added.
